source.note: single-card witness of the cast-count PAYOFF arm — a cast-trigger subscription (stem=cast) bound card-defined to a token EMIT (stem=deployment:creature[token]). Oracle (single line): 'Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, create a 1/1 red Elemental creature token.' Live engine ports (dumps/card-ports.json, verified 2026-07-17): consume family=cast, label 'trigger:cast:instant+sorcery+spell:controlled' (stem=cast, isSelf=false, tier=Green, line 0 spans [0,45]) + emit family=token, label 'emit:token:creature:elemental:controlled' (stem=deployment:creature, isSelf=false, tier=Green, line 0 spans [46,89]). NO parse gap: both ports are Stage-2 structured (the consume serves the structured 'cast' stem, exactly as Aang does; the emit serves the deployment:creature token rung, exactly as Grave Titan / Chatterfang do), so this is a faithful witness, not a wish. RULE DISCIPLINE (checked the rollup FIRST): the intra-card binding 'whenever you cast -> create a token' is a subscription->payoff flow that is CARD-DEFINED (self-certifying, no rule id), mirroring guttersnipe E2 (cast-trigger payoff -> draw), archaeomancer E1 (ETB subscription -> recur emit), and aang's would-be (but unported) cast->lifelink. So NO new rule and NO sibling is minted; this gold CORROBORATES two already-witnessed stems: (1) the 'cast' event-verb stem (first witnessed by aang-the-last-airbender, A1; this is the SECOND witness, climbing it) and (2) the 'deployment:creature'[token] emit (grave-titan-x-anointed-procession, chatterfang C-tokens). CAST-CONSUMER CONTRAST (the task's 'compare to cast:spell consumers'): Young Pyromancer's consume is the AANG-family cast-WATCH subscription (isSelf=false, control=you — watches YOUR casts), NOT the Ghostly Flicker-family recast DRIVER (cast:spell:self, isSelf=true, watching ITSELF to be re-cast). So no policy:recast:* rule is in play — a recast policy refuels a self-recasting spell; a cast-trigger subscription simply fires a payoff on each of your casts. SCAFFOLD SURFACE (value accretion only, no new axis): the cast filter 'instant+sorcery' accretes the values instant, sorcery to the subtype axis values_seen — the exact precedent aang.json set by accreting 'lesson' to the same axis (the subtype axis already carries top-level card-type values 'creature' and 'land', so instant/sorcery are consistent). The axis KEY (subtype) and its licensed stem ('cast', already listed) are both in the closed set, so only values_seen accretes; no axis is invented. PARSE GAP REPORTED (why Young Pyromancer, not Storm-Kiln Artist): the magecraft 'cast OR copy' variant (Storm-Kiln Artist: 'Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, create a Treasure token') projects as a COARSER un-stemmed label — live family=castorcopyspell, label 'castorcopyspell:instant+sorcery+spell', with NO stem field — unlike Young Pyromancer's clean family=cast/stem=cast. So the magecraft cast-or-copy consume is NOT yet ADR-3-stem-projected (a parser target: castorcopyspell -> stem=cast [+ a copy alias]); Young Pyromancer's plain 'whenever you cast' is the faithfully-stemmed witness. No popularity COUNT is available in the testbed corpus (edhrec/price absent), so source.popularity is omitted (not fabricated from a rank); csb=false (a value engine, not a documented Commander Spellbook loop).

Young Pyromancer.note: THE CAST-COUNT DRIVER — 'Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell' (live trigger:cast:instant+sorcery+spell:controlled; family=cast, stem=cast, isSelf=false, tier=Green, spans [0,45]). A player-action subscription on the bare EVENT verb cast (casting a spell is a discrete occurrence, CR 601). Mirrors aang.json A1 (the cast-WATCH subscription family): control=you decodes 'controlled' (you cast); subtype='instant+sorcery' is the watched card-type filter ('spell' is implicit in the cast verb, per aang), carried honestly so the consume is NOT over-broadened to all casts. isSelf=false — this is a subscription watching YOUR casts, NOT a recast driver watching ITSELF (contrast Ghostly Flicker G0, cast:spell:self, isSelf=true), so no policy:recast:* rule applies. The filter accretes instant, sorcery to the subtype axis values_seen (see source.note).

THE PAYOFF EMIT — 'create a 1/1 red Elemental creature token' (live emit:token:creature:elemental:controlled; family=token, stem=deployment:creature, tier=Green, spans [46,89]). A positive token deployment, the value paid out per qualifying cast. Same port shape as grave-titan.G1 / chatterfang C-tokens (token=true, control=you); color=red / pt=1/1 / subtype=elemental enriched from the oracle (mirroring grave-titan's zombie/black/2-2 enrichment beyond its label). qty=1 (one token per firing).

notes: THE CAST-COUNT PAYOFF ARM — 'Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, create a 1/1 red Elemental creature token' — a deterministic card-defined flow from the cast subscription to the token emit; structural (self-certifying), no rule dependency (CR 603.2 -> the triggered effect). unit=single-card: a port derivation witnessing the cast subscription + its token payoff, no cycle closed. A loop would need the payoff to refuel a cast (e.g. Storm-Kiln Artist's Treasure -> mana -> recast a spell), which needs a second recastable piece and is mana-negative for most spells (1 Treasure < a spell's cost) — not closed here
